title: Breaking Points: How Transformer Vulnerabilities Reveal Paths to Faster Inference

contributions.purpose: 逐层脆弱性分析,定位相变层
contributions.mechanism: 5编码器×5噪声控制评测,层级鲁棒度度量R(l)
contributions.evaluation: 第3、8层出现一致脆弱性相变(Friedman χ2=178.43, p<0.001, Cohen's d>3.0)
contributions.source_quote: we present a systematic layer-wise vulnerability analysis that identifies consistent vulnerability patterns at layers 3 and 8 in 12-layer models (p < 0.001, Cohen's d > 3.0)

contributions.evaluation: RoBERTa 0.787 vs ELECTRA 0.607;句法扰动最伤(均值0.548)
contributions.source_quote: RoBERTa achieves 0.787 average robustness compared to 0.607 for ELECTRA.

contributions.mechanism: 丢弃非相变层(1,5,10)保留关键相变层
contributions.evaluation: 实测1.28×加速(batch32为1.31×),保留92%鲁棒度(理论上限1.33×)
contributions.source_quote: strategic layer dropout achieves 1.28x actual speedup (1.31x at batch=32) while preserving 92% of the original robustness score

contributions.evaluation: 真实噪声比合成扰动相对难15-20%(BERT OCR降12.5%,RoBERTa降6.6%)
contributions.source_quote: real-world noise proving 15-20% relatively more challenging than synthetic perturbations

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work extends these findings by quantifying how this specialization creates vulnerability to specific noise types and identifying consistent transition patterns within architectural families.

notes: checklist自报:假设[C]、实验设计[D]、分析[C]、写作[D](多为AI),并自认理论框架AI-generated。数据红旗(严重,图文数字自相矛盾):(1)Figure 1标注的加速为Strategic-15%=2.47×、Random-15%=1.89×、Aggressive-25%=3.21×、图内'Average 2.47×',与正文/摘要反复宣称的'1.28×平均加速、理论上限1.33×'直接冲突,且dropout百分比(15/25/50%)前后不一;(2)Figure 2把句法相recovery标为'22% recovery',正文却写52%鲁棒度;(3)样本计数52,500=2,100×5模型×5噪声,但2,100本身已=420×5噪声,噪声被重复乘一次(应为10,500),算术自相矛盾;(4)Theorem 1用互信息二/三阶导定义相变,完整证明推给不存在的Appendix B.1(幻影引用);(5)消融给出'127%检测能力提升/73%下降'但'detection accuracy'从未定义。
